draft.title: Viking traders and settlers
card: Vikings were not only raiders. Many were traders who travelled along rivers and seas to buy and sell goods, as far as Baghdad in the Middle East.
Viking traders carried goods such as furs, amber and enslaved people to distant markets. They often returned with silver and other goods.
Many Vikings settled in new lands. They founded or took over towns such as Dublin and York, and gained land in Normandy in France.
Others sailed across the North Atlantic to settle Iceland and Greenland. From Greenland, Vikings reached North America about 1000 CE.
draft.remember: Vikings traded far and wide, and many made new homes overseas.

a.q: Which of these shows that Vikings were more than raiders?
opts: They travelled to Baghdad to trade goods
They attacked towns along the coast of England
They sailed in light and fast longships
They farmed small plots of land in Scandinavia
a.why: Trading in distant markets such as Baghdad shows peaceful contact as well as violence. Attacking coastal towns was raiding, which is the idea the question asks us to look beyond.
a.clue: Look for the option that is not about fighting.

b.q: Freya's family leave Norway and build a farm in Iceland, where they plan to stay. What is the best word for what they did?
opts: Settled in a new land
Raided a rich monastery
Traded silver in Baghdad
Conquered the city of York
b.why: Moving to a new land to live there is settling. Raiding and trading are different activities, and the family have no plan to attack York or any other place.
b.clue: They plan to stay and live there.

a.best: They travelled to Baghdad to trade goods
also_right: They farmed small plots of land in Scandinavia

problems.detail: Farming in Scandinavia also shows Vikings were more than raiders, so a careful teacher could defend it. The clue 'not about fighting' fits longships and farming as well as trading, so it does not single out the intended answer.
The stem asks for 'the best word', but every option is a phrase. Ask for 'the best description' instead.

a.q: Ulf takes furs and amber from Sweden to Baghdad, exchanges them there, and comes home with silver. What was his trip?
opts: Trading goods in a distant market
Raiding a rich, poorly defended town
Settling in a new land to farm it
Exploring new lands across the Atlantic
a.why: Ulf exchanged his furs and amber for silver in Baghdad, which is trade. It was not settling, because he came home rather than staying to live there.
